// Splices an H.264 SEI message of MDPM user data, as AVCHD camcorders
// write it, into an Annex B stream after its first PPS.
//
// Usage: go run splice.go <in.h264> <out.h264> <tz byte> <yyyymmddhhmmss>
//
// The MDPM: the recording time (tags 0x18, 0x19), a GPS position 51°30'N
// 0°7'30"W at 35.5 m (0xb1 to 0xba), the make Sony (0xe0) and a model
// name (0xe4 to 0xe6).
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
)

func bcd(n int) byte { return byte(n/10<<4 | n%10) }

func main() {
	in, _ := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	tz, _ := strconv.ParseUint(os.Args[3], 0, 8)
	t := os.Args[4]
	num := func(s string) int { n, _ := strconv.Atoi(s); return n }
	y, mo, d, h, mi, s := num(t[0:4]), num(t[4:6]), num(t[6:8]), num(t[8:10]), num(t[10:12]), num(t[12:14])
	rat := func(n, d uint16) []byte { return []byte{byte(n >> 8), byte(n), byte(d >> 8), byte(d)} }
	entries := []struct {
		tag  byte
		data []byte
	}{
		{0x18, []byte{byte(tz), bcd(y / 100), bcd(y % 100), bcd(mo)}},
		{0x19, []byte{bcd(d), bcd(h), bcd(mi), bcd(s)}},
		{0xb0, []byte{2, 2, 0, 0}},
		{0xb1, []byte("N\x00\x00\x00")},
		{0xb2, rat(51, 1)}, {0xb3, rat(30, 1)}, {0xb4, rat(0, 1)},
		{0xb5, []byte("W\x00\x00\x00")},
		{0xb6, rat(0, 1)}, {0xb7, rat(7, 1)}, {0xb8, rat(30, 1)},
		{0xb9, []byte{0, 0, 0, 0}},
		{0xba, rat(71, 2)},
		{0xe0, []byte{0x01, 0x08, 0x30, 0x01}},
		{0xe4, []byte("HDR-")}, {0xe5, []byte("CX40")}, {0xe6, []byte("5\x00\x00\x00")},
	}
	msg := []byte("\x17\xee\x8c\x60\xf8\x4d\x11\xd9\x8c\xd6\x08\x00\x20\x0c\x9a\x66MDPM")
	msg = append(msg, byte(len(entries)))
	for _, e := range entries {
		msg = append(append(msg, e.tag), e.data...)
	}
	rbsp := []byte{5} // user_data_unregistered
	n := len(msg)
	for ; n >= 255; n -= 255 {
		rbsp = append(rbsp, 255)
	}
	rbsp = append(append(rbsp, byte(n)), msg...)
	rbsp = append(rbsp, 0x80) // rbsp_trailing_bits
	// Emulation prevention (H.264 7.4.1).
	nal := []byte{0, 0, 0, 1, 0x06}
	zeros := 0
	for _, c := range rbsp {
		if zeros >= 2 && c <= 3 {
			nal = append(nal, 3)
			zeros = 0
		}
		nal = append(nal, c)
		if c == 0 {
			zeros++
		} else {
			zeros = 0
		}
	}
	// After the first PPS (NAL type 8): before the next start code.
	at := -1
	for i := 0; i+4 < len(in); i++ {
		if in[i] == 0 && in[i+1] == 0 && in[i+2] == 1 && in[i+3]&0x1F == 8 {
			next := bytes.Index(in[i+3:], []byte{0, 0, 1})
			at = i + 3 + next
			if at > 0 && in[at-1] == 0 {
				at-- // a 4-byte start code
			}
			break
		}
	}
	if at < 0 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "no PPS")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	out := append(append(append([]byte(nil), in[:at]...), nal...), in[at:]...)
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[2], out, 0o644); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
